description.en: A tiny coalified flower has radially arranged carpels surrounding a central column.
description.zh: 微小炭化花具有围绕中央柱放射排列的心皮。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Monetianthus mirus, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied. An enlarged educational display would require an explicit scale label.
scientific_scope.zh: Monetianthus mirus 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。 放大教学展示必须明确标注比例。

distinctness.en: Central column and multicarpellate ring distinguish it from the broad five-sepal Florissantia fossil.
distinctness.zh: 中央柱及多心皮环区别于宽五萼Florissantia花化石。

modeling_brief.en: Reserve for a labeled enlarged educational specimen; block the central ring before microscopic details and do not invent petals.
modeling_brief.zh: 仅供明确标注放大的教学标本；先构建中央环，不臆造花瓣或显微细节。

assets.uncertainty: Microscopic scale and uncertain perianth phyllotaxis need a readability/form review before production.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Monetianthus mirus, a nymphaealean flower from the Early Cretaceous of Portugal
sources.supports: Radial fossil flower with central column and surrounding carpels.

description.en: Floating compound leaf rosettes combine toothed leaflets with finely divided submerged foliage.
description.zh: 浮生复叶莲座由齿缘小叶组成，并具细裂沉水叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Quereuxia angulata; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Quereuxia angulata 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Compound toothed rosettes and contrasting submerged leaves differ from simple-leaved floating araceous plants.
distinctness.zh: 齿缘复叶莲座及异形沉水叶区别于浮生天南星类单叶。

modeling_brief.en: Make the compound leaf connections visible and keep underwater branches spare; never substitute a modern Trapa nut.
modeling_brief.zh: 清楚呈现复叶连接，简化水下分枝，不替换为现代菱角。

assets.uncertainty: Family affinity is unresolved; Trapago is a nomenclatural synonym, not another asset.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Epidermal features of the floating leaves of Quereuxia angulata
sources.supports: Compound floating rosettes, toothed leaflets and submerged divided leaves.

description.en: A fossil infructescence carries paired nutlets with conspicuous lobed bracts.
description.zh: 化石果序带成对小坚果及明显裂苞片。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Palaeocarpinus, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Palaeocarpinus 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Paired bract wings around nutlets differ from a single continuous Pteleoidea fruit wing.
distinctness.zh: 围绕坚果的成对苞翅区别于Pteleoidea单一连续果翅。

modeling_brief.en: Use a small axis and repeated paired fruit-bract units; express the lobes as silhouette geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 使用小轴及重复成对果苞单元，把苞裂片表现为轮廓几何。

assets.uncertainty: Select a species plate for exact bract incision; no separate foliage asset.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Palaeocarpinus from the Paleocene of Alberta
sources.supports: Paired fruits and lobed bracts in Palaeocarpinus infructescences.

description.en: A small multicellular algal fossil has an erect branching thallus.
description.zh: 小型多细胞藻化石具有直立分枝藻体。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Proterocladus antiquus, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Proterocladus antiquus 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: An organized branched thallus provides an early green-algal teaching form, rather than a microbial rock texture.
distinctness.zh: 有组织分枝藻体提供早期绿藻教学形态，而非微生物岩石纹理。

modeling_brief.en: Reserve a labeled enlarged specimen relief; use the visible branch topology and omit cell-wall microstructure.
modeling_brief.zh: 保留为明确标注放大的标本浮雕，使用可见分枝拓扑，省略细胞壁显微结构。

assets.uncertainty: Near the Mesoproterozoic-Neoproterozoic boundary; microscopic diagnostic features and thumbnail readability require review.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit. Proterocladus antiquus is approximately one billion years old, near the Tonian boundary; neoproterozoic is intentionally broad and boundary uncertainty is retained.
